Definition: sprinkling; hence, a sprinkling (or autumnal showers)
BiblicalUsage: Yoreh is the early rain, the autumnal showers that soften the ground for sowing. In Deuteronomy 11:14 God promises, "I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain." Jeremiah 5:24 rebukes a people who never say in their heart, "Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the early rain is God's picture of provision that comes on time, because the rain in Deuteronomy 11:14 is a promise tied to obedience, and Jeremiah 5:24 is right to call out a heart that takes the rain and forgets the Giver.
